t: A pocket game console in a metal case that you can program yourself.
steps: Buy PicoSystem from Pimoroni or a reseller such as The Pi Hut.
Get a USB-C data cable, as one is not in the box.
Switch it on and play the built-in game Super Square Bros.
Install the free Thonny editor on your computer.
Hold the X button while you switch it on to get the RPI-RP2 drive.
Drag the PicoSystem MicroPython file from the PicoSystem repo onto that drive.
Open Thonny and run a short drawing example from the wiki.
Try the 32blit SDK later for bigger games in C++.
meta: Open Board. From $65. A few stores.
